blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.
blocks.zh: 目前的视频物品清除方法有令人望而却步的延迟(每段视频分钟)和非因果处理,无法实时互动. 我们介绍StreamErase, 允许在单一的GPU上有最多26个FPS流流层的子秒空。 我们的方法首先用面具输入来扩充一个文本到视频模型,生成高质量的视频,可以抹去目标对象,合成一致的背景,但不会对苍蝇进行推论. 因此,我们逐渐将消除能力从强大的双向基础模型转移到高效的单向流消除器,从而能够在不牺牲视觉忠诚的情况下实现长视距消除。 在制作视频时会出现若干关键挑战,时间跨度长,可能无限:(1) 缩小域间差距,从关于有限长度的培训,推导到长视野;(2) 通过防止错误积累来保持高质量;(3) 保持快速推论,而不会随着环境的增长而增加计算成本。 为了应对这些挑战,我们精心设计了滑窗因果注意和注意吸收。 通过在训练期间将自滚与注意力吸收和KV缓存滚动,我们用固定的上下文窗口模拟推论时间推算,使任意长视频能够恒速生成. 最后,我们建立了一个专门的基准LongErase,用于流动的长视频对象清除. 我们的模型与现有的视频对象消除模型相比,实现了强效的性能,并且对现实世界的视频场景进行了很好的概括,独一无二地实现了无限长的流线化. 使用StreamErase,用户可以输入一个面具,看到擦除结果实时展开,提供真正互动的经验.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The ultimate goal of video object erasing is to empower creators and systems to seamlessly remove unwanted dynamic content from video streams in real time while preserving visual realism. Although recent video diffusion models ( Li et al., 2025a ; Bian et al., 2025 ; Zi et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Miao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) have made impressive strides toward this goal, the experience remains largely confined to offline, batch-processing workflows.
blocks.zh: 视频对象消除的最终目标是增强创造者和系统的能力,使其在保持视觉现实的同时,能够无缝地实时从视频流中去除不受欢迎的动态内容. 虽然最近的视频传播模式(Li等人,2025a); Bian等人,《2025年》;Zi等人,《2025年a》;Jiang等人,《2025年》;Miao等人,《2025年》;Fu等人,《2026年》)在实现这一目标方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展,这些经验基本上仍然局限于离线、批处理工作流程。

blocks.en:
The promise of real-time video erasing is currently hindered by several fundamental constraints.
First, generation is too slow for interactive deployment. For example, synthesizing a 5-second video clip with ROSE ( Miao et al., 2025 ) takes 2 minutes, trapping users in frustrating ”render-and-wait” delay cycles.
Second, existing paradigms are inherently non-causal, since diffusion models process the entire sequence in parallel with bidirectional attention. A user cannot see any partial results until the entire erase is complete.
Finally, the inability to generate more than a few seconds of video severely limits the scope for any meaningful or extended creative expression.
Together, these constraints (slow, non-causal, and short-duration generation) undermine the potential for a truly interactive creative experience.
blocks.zh:
实时视频删除的承诺目前受到若干基本限制的阻碍。
第一,一代人对于互动部署来说太慢。 例如,用ROSE(Miao等人,2025年)合成5秒的视频剪辑需要2分钟,使用户陷入“投降等待”的拖延周期。
第二,现有的范式本质上是非因果的,因为扩散模型将整个序列与双向关注平行处理. 用户无法看到任何部分结果, 直到整个擦除完成 。
最后,无法产生超过几秒的视频严重限制了任何有意义的或扩展的创造性表达的范围.
这些制约因素(缓慢、无因果关系和短时间生成)加在一起,削弱了真正互动的创造性经验的潜力。

blocks.en: To overcome these challenges, we introduce StreamErase, a streaming video erasing framework that progressively transfers the erasing capability of an offline bidirectional diffusion model into an efficient autoregressive generator for real-time interactive erasing.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些挑战,我们引入了StreamErase,这是一个流式视频消除框架,它逐步将离线双向传播模型的消除能力转移到一个高效的自动递减生成器,用于实时交互消除.

blocks.en: Specifically, we first fine-tune a pretrained diffusion model with full bidirectional attention, obtaining in a powerful bidirectional video eraser that serves as the teacher for subsequent distillation. We then replace bidirectional attention with causal attention to construct an autoregressive diffusion model, and apply teacher forcing followed by ODE distillation to obtain a causal video eraser requiring four denoising steps. Finally, we perform Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), using the bidirectional video eraser as the teacher and the causal video eraser as the student, enabling the streaming model to inherit the high-fidelity erasing capability of the offline model while further compressing generation to a single denoising step for real-time inference.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们首先微调了一种预先训练的传播模型, 并充分双向关注, 在一个强大的双向视频擦拭器中获得, 它可以作为教师 用于随后的蒸馏。 然后我们用双向的注意力代替因果的注意力来构建一个自旋扩散模型,并应用老师强迫,然后ODE蒸馏,以获得一个因果视频擦除器,需要四个去诺步骤. 最后,我们用双向视频擦除器作为老师,用因果视频擦除器作为学生来进行分配匹配消化(DMD),使流线模型能够继承离线模型的高真消除能力,同时进一步压缩生成到一个单一的去诺化步骤进行实时推论.

blocks.en:
Causal generation, however, is prone to error accumulation and drift over long horizons.
Prior work in large language models has shown that initial tokens play a crucial role in stable streaming generation ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) .
This insight drives our attention sinking mechanism with rolling KV caches, which we incorporate directly into training to simulate inference extrapolation distributions, ensuring stable, indefinite-length generation at constant latency through fixed context windows.
blocks.zh:
然而,因果生成容易发生误差累积和漂移到远处。
先前大型语言模型的著作表明,最初的代号在稳定的流水生成中起着关键作用(Xiao等人,2023年).
这种洞察力用滚动的 KV 缓存推动我们的注意力沉降机制,我们直接将它纳入训练中模拟推论推断分布,通过固定的上下文窗口,确保稳定,无限期的生成.

blocks.en:
StreamErase achieves 26.06 FPS with sub-second latency on a single H200 GPU. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that StreamErase achieves competitive visual and temporal quality across diverse erasing scenarios, while being more than 46 × \times faster than recent methods.
Furthermore, StreamErase maintains stable visual and temporal quality when extended from short 5-second clips to substantially longer 30-second videos.
StreamErase transforms video generation from a passive waiting experience into an active creative process, where users can continuously interact with and guide the generation in real-time.
blocks.zh:
StreamErase实现26.06 FPS,在单H200GPU上具有次秒的潜伏性. 广泛的实验和模拟表明,StreamErase在各种消除假想中实现了具有竞争力的视觉和时间质量,同时比最近的方法更快地超过46xx时间。
此外,StreamErase保持稳定的视觉和时间质量,从短短的5秒短片段延长到大大延长的30秒短片段。
StreamErase将视频生成从被动的等待体验转变为主动的创造性过程,用户可以与视频生成持续互动并实时引导.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Inpainting
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频油漆

blocks.en:
Video inpainting aims to reconstruct missing regions specified by a sequence of masks.
Early video inpainting methods primarily used 3D CNNs ( Chang et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2020 ) to model spatial-temporal features, but their limited receptive fields hindered long-range propagation.
Subsequently, optical flow ( Kim et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2020 ; Zou et al., 2021 ) and homography Lee et al. (2019) ; Cai et al. (2022) were introduced to guide pixel propagation.
To improve efficiency and accuracy, ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) proposed ProPainter, combining optical flow and attention mechanisms.
Recently, with the rise of diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , diffusion-based video inpainting has emerged ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Zi et al., 2025b ) . ( Li et al., 2025a ) proposed DiffuEraser, extending the image inpainting model BrushNet ( Ju et al., 2024 ) to videos via a two-stage training scheme.
Despite these advances, existing inpainting models often overlook object effects, resulting in incomplete or visually inconsistent object removal.
blocks.zh:
视频涂装旨在重建由一系列口罩指定的缺失区域.
早期的视频涂装方法主要使用3D CNN(Chan等人,2019年;Wang等人,2019年;Hu等人,2020年)来建模时空特征,但其有限的可接受领域阻碍了远程传播.
随后,光学流动 (Kim等人,2019年;Li等人,2020年;Zou等人,2021年)和homography Lee等人(2019年);Cai等人(2022年)被引入来指导像素传播.
为了提高效率和准确性,(周等人,2023年)提出ProPainter,结合光学流和注意力机制.
最近,随着传播模式的兴起(Ho等人,2020年),基于传播的视频涂装出现(Shi等人,2024年;Zi等人,2025年b). (Li等人,2025年a)提出DiffuEraser,将图像涂装模式BrushNet(Ju等人,2024年)通过两阶段的培训计划扩展到视频.
尽管取得了这些进步,但现有的涂装模型往往忽略了对象效应,导致物体清除不完整或视觉上不一致.

blocks.en:
Video Object Erasing is a specialized form of inpainting that requires precise modeling of object-induced visual effects to achieve realistic results.
Early methods ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) attempt to adapt image erasing models to video by processing frames individually, but struggle to maintain temporal consistency in dynamic scenes.
Minmax-Remover ( Zi et al., 2025a ) simplifies a pre-trained video generator by removing text inputs and cross-attention layers and introducing a minimax objective.
ROSE Miao et al. (2025) introduces a synthesized dataset comprising multiple environments, along with a side-effect mask predictor.
EffectErase ( Fu et al., 2026 ) further provides a large-scale dataset of paired real and synthetic videos and proposes an effect-aware removal framework based on reciprocal learning.
Despite their impressive quality, these methods are fundamentally limited to offline processing because they rely on diffusion models with full bidirectional attention. This constraint prevents their use in real-time applications.
blocks.zh:
视频对象擦除是一种专门化的涂装形式,需要精确地建模物体引起的视觉效果,以达到现实的效果.
早期方法(Yu等人,2025年;Wei等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年)试图通过单独处理帧来使图像擦除模型适应视频,但努力在动态场景中保持时间一致性.
Minmax-Remover(Zi 等人,2025a)通过删除文本输入和交叉注意层,引入一个迷你max目标,简化了预训视频生成器.
罗斯 释等. (2025)引入了包含多个环境的合成数据集,以及副作用遮罩预测器.
EffectErase(Fu等人,2026年)进一步提供了成对真实和合成视频的大规模数据集,并提出了基于对等学习的效应感知清除框架.
这些方法尽管质量令人印象深刻,但根本上仅限于离线处理,因为它们依赖于完全双向关注的传播模型. 这种限制阻碍了它们用于实时应用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Streaming Autoregressive Video Models.
blocks.zh: 2.2 流转自递视频模型.

blocks.en:
Streaming autoregressive generation effectively overcomes the latency bottlenecks of offline models.
Foundational works like Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and StreamDiffusion ( Kodaira et al., 2025 ) reformulates denoising as block-wise sequential processing, enabling causal decoding.
Follow-up works ( Yin et al., 2024c ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025b ) combined causal attention, KV-cache, and distillation to compress multi-step diffusion into a few denoising steps, enabling efficient online generation.
However, these approaches either exhibit severe color drifts beyond the training horizon or require complex long-video finetuning, which poses challenges for controllable video generation.
blocks.zh:
流畅的自递生成有效地克服了离线模型的延迟瓶颈.
基础作品有"传播强化法"(Chen等人,2024年)和"流体分解法"(Kodaira等人,2025年)等,重新命名为按块顺序处理,使因果解码成为可能.
后续作品(Yin等人,2024c;Chen等人,2025a;Teng等人,2025;Guo等人,2025;Huang等人,2026;Lin等人,2025b)结合了因果注意,KV-cache,并进行了蒸馏,将多步传播压缩为几个去诺步骤,使得高效的在线生成成为可能.
然而,这些方法要么呈现出超出训练视野的严重颜色漂移,要么需要复杂的长视频微调,这给可控视频生成带来了挑战.

blocks.en: 2.3 Diffusion Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.3 扩散扩散

blocks.en:
Accelerating reverse diffusion ( Song et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song and Dhariwal, 2023 ) is crucial for real-time performance.
Early one-step distillation efforts focused on the image domain, utilizing techniques like Rectified Flow (InstaFlow ( Liu et al., 2023 ) ), target score distillation (TSD-SR ( Dong et al., 2025 ) ), and Distribution Matching Distillation ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , alongside progressive adversarial distillation (SDXL-Lightning ( Lin et al., 2024 ) ).
These advancements have naturally extended to the video domain, enabling efficient one-step generation (AAPT ( Lin et al., 2025a ) ), restoration (SeedVR2 ( Wang et al., 2025 ) ), and super-resolution (DOVE ( Chen et al., 2025b ) ).
FlashVSR ( Zhuang et al., 2025 ) achieves real-time streaming video super-resolution via a three-stage distillation pipeline designed to progressively accelerate latent rendering. Similarly, PersonaLive ( Li et al., 2025b ) leverages appearance distillation for live portrait animation.
However, these tasks involve low-level pixel mapping or structurally constrained regions. Directly transferring these schemes to general video erasing degrades high-fidelity details.
blocks.zh:
加速反向扩散 (Song等人,2023年;Wang等人,2023年;Salimans and Ho,2022年;Song and Dhariwal,2023年)对于实时演出至关重要.
早期的一步蒸馏工作侧重于图像领域,利用了诸如Recorized Flow(InstaFlow(Liu等人,2023年)),目标分数蒸馏(TSD-SR(Dong等人,2025年)),以及分布匹配蒸馏(Yin等人,2024年b); Yin等人,2024a),与渐进式对抗式蒸馏(SDXL-Lightning(Lin等人,2024))并列.
这些进步自然扩展到视频领域,使得高效的单步生成(APT(Lin等人,2025a)),恢复(SeedVR2(Wang等人,2025)),以及超解析(DOVE(Chen等人,2025b)).
FlashVSR( Zhu等,2025年)通过三级蒸馏管道实现实时流视频超分辨率,旨在逐步加速潜在渲染. 同样,PersonaLive(Li等人,2025年b)为现场肖像动画利用外观蒸馏.
然而,这些任务涉及低级像素映射或结构受限区域. 将这些计划直接转移到一般的视频中去,会降低高可信度的细节.

In brief, StreamErase is implemented as an inpainting model continued from the foundation video generative models (the Wan2.1 model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) in this paper). Following the
general architecture in diffusion-based inpainting models ( Miao et al., 2025 ) , we extend the model input with the original input video together with object masks.

blocks.en:
Existing video erasing diffusion models typically require around 50 denoising steps to generate high-quality video and presume that the entire input video and mask is known before generation.
To enable streaming erasing,
we propose a three-stage distillation pipeline that effectively transfers the high-fidelity erasing capabilities of a foundation model into an ultra-fast, unbidirectional streaming erasor. An overview of the framework is illustrated in Fig. 3 .

Stage 1: Bidirectional Teacher Training. To establish a powerful offline erasing foundation, we first train a bidirectional teacher model ϵ θ bid \epsilon_{\theta}^{\text{bid}} using the full temporal-spatial attention mechanism over 50 denoising steps. Building upon the Wan2.1 backbone ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , the model is optimized using ℒ total \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} defined above.
This stage endows the foundation model with versatile video erasing capabilities and side-effect awareness, serving as a high-fidelity teacher for subsequent distillation.

Inspired by recent causal video generation frameworks ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , we adopt a chunk-wise causal attention design M causal M_{\text{causal}} that restricts temporal tokens from attending to future video chunks, establishing a Teacher Forcing mechanism essential for streaming synthesis.
Following the initialization protocol in Causal Forcing, we adapt the causal model for video erasing and distill it into a four-step causal student by regressing on ODE solution pairs sampled from the teacher.
The student generator ϵ θ causal \epsilon_{\theta}^{\text{causal}} is optimized via the same erasing objective ℒ total ​ ( M causal ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}(M_{\text{causal}}) .
This stage produces a robust four-step causal student generator, serving as the initialization for subsequent distillation.

Stage 3: DMD One-Step Distillation. To achieve ultra-low latency while mitigating accumulated shift errors during continuous streaming (illustrated in Fig. 9 ), we perform advanced step-distillation using Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD).
Recent studies on one-step streaming video diffusion focus on video generation, typically requiring clean past frames as input for motion plausibility. Teacher forcing (conditioning on ground truth) ( Lin et al., 2025b ) causes error accumulation during inference, while student forcing (conditioning on predicted latents) ( Huang et al., 2026 ) alleviates this but requires sequential unfolding, reducing efficiency.

Crucially, this design resolves the train–infer gap. By discarding AR dependencies on previously generated latents and performing one-step generation conditioned on input video, mask and noise, the model avoids feeding its own prediction errors back into future steps.

Consequently, G θ G_{\theta} focuses purely on localized content restoration while enabling high-fidelity, single-step video erasing in real-time.

blocks.en: 3.3 Long Video Streaming Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 长视频流传生成

blocks.en:
Attention sink. Autoregressive generation with sliding-window attention, as adopted in Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , is prone to quality degradation and drift during long-video extrapolation.
Prior work in large language models has shown that initial tokens play a crucial role in stable streaming generation ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) .
MotionStream ( Shin et al., 2026 ) further observes a similar phenomenon in video diffusion models.
Inspired by this, we adapt the attention sink concept to our video erasing model by maintaining a local attention window while
preserving tokens from the initial frame as a fixed anchor throughout generation.
In our chunk-wise autoregressive setup, this sinking mechanism prevents the model from drifting during long-video extrapolation, even when trained only on short sequences limited by the teacher model.
blocks.zh:
注意下沉。 在Self Forcing(Huang等人,2026年)中采纳的带有滑窗注意力的自递性生成,在长视频外推中容易发生质量退化和漂移.
先前大型语言模型的著作表明,最初的代号在稳定的流水生成中起着关键作用(Xiao等人,2023年).
MotionStream(Shin等人,2026年)进一步观察到视频传播模型中的类似现象.
受此启发,我们通过保持本地的注意力窗口, 将注意力沉积的概念 适应我们的视频消除模式
将初始框架中的符号保存为整个世代的固定锚。
在我们的块式自旋设置中,这种沉没机制使得模型在长视频外推时无法漂移,即使只接受师范模型限制的短序列训练.

blocks.en:
Inference. To maintain continuous streaming generation over long videos without quality degradation, our inference procedure strictly mirrors the training setup to achieve an exact train-test alignment.
Specifically, we maintain a KV cache containing S S chunks from the initial frames and a fixed-size local window of recent W W chunks. As new tokens are generated, this local window is rolled forward to maintain a constant size. For positional encoding, we store the final, RoPE-applied values for the static sink tokens, while tokens in the rolling window store pre-RoPE activations and receive positional indices dynamically based on their current cache location. Because this entire mechanism is simulated during training, the model seamlessly handles the discontinuity between sink and window tokens. We further analyze the effects of attention sink and window size in Sec 4.2 .
blocks.zh:
推论. 为了在没有质量退化的长视频上保持连续流传生成,我们的推论程序严格地反映了训练设置,以实现准确的列车测试对齐.
具体来说,我们维持一个KV缓存,从初始帧中包含S S块,以及最近W W块的固定大小本地窗口. 随着新的符号生成,这个本地窗口被向前滚动,以保持一个恒定大小. 对于位置编码,我们存储静态沉淀器符号的最终,RoPE应用值,而标志则存储在滚动窗口商店的RoPE激活前,并根据其当前的缓存位置动态接收位置指数. 由于整个机理都是在训练期间模拟的,所以模型无缝地处理着水槽和窗口符之间的不连续性. 我们进一步分析注意力沉积和窗口大小在第4.2节的影响。

Evaluation Data. We evaluate StreamErase against existing methods on three datasets:
(1) ROSE-Benchmark , a synthetic dataset with 60 paired videos;
(2) VOR-Eval : a real-world dataset comprising 43 video pairs; (3) LongErase , our newly proposed benchmark for long-video object removal.
Existing benchmarks focus primarily on short clips due to the bidirectional attention constraints of diffusion models.
To bridge this gap, we introduce LongErase , a challenging real-world benchmark consisting of 80 video sequences, each 30 seconds long, complete with ground-truth counterparts.

现有的基准主要侧重于短片段,因为传播模式的双向注意力限制。
为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了LongErase,这是一个具有挑战性的现实世界基准,由80个视频序列组成,每30秒长,与地面真相对应方完成。

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods.
blocks.zh: 4.1 与最新方法的比较。

blocks.en: We compare StreamErase with several state-of-the-art image inpainting methods ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) applied in a per-frame manner, video inpainting methods ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ) , and advanced video object removal methods ( Zi et al., 2025a ; Miao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了StreamErase与几种先进的图像涂装方法(赵等人,2025年;余等人,2025年),以每帧方式应用的视频涂装方法(江等人,2025年;周等人,2023年;李等人,2025年a),以及先进的视频物品清除方法(Zi等人,2025年a; Miao等人,2025年;Fu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Table 2: Quantitative evaluation on LongErase. Comparison on 5-second clips and long-term performance on 30-second videos. The best score is bolded.
blocks.zh: 表2:长耳草的定量评价。 对比5秒剪辑和30秒视频的长期表现. 最佳成绩是大胆的.

blocks.en:
Quantitative Evaluation. As shown in Tab. 1 , current image inpainting methods ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) process video frames independently using 2D models, and thus struggle to preserve temporal consistency across frames.
Recent video inpainting methods ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) do not explicitly model object side effects, leading to unnatural removal outcomes.
Existing video object removal methods ( Miao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) lack spatiotemporal correlation modeling between the object and its side effects, and consequently often produce artifacts and residual traces of the removed objects.
Overall, StreamErase consistently achieves strong performance on both ROSE-Benchmark and VOR-Eval while operating at 26.06 FPS, substantially improving the efficiency over existing methods.
Beyond standard short-video evaluation, Tab. 2 assesses StreamErase on both 5-second and 30-second videos. StreamErase remains highly competitive on short clips and maintains comparable visual quality when extended to 30 seconds with minimal degradation, demonstrating its scalability to longer sequences.
blocks.zh:
定量评价。 如Tab. 1所示,当前图像涂装方法(赵 al等人,2025年;于 al等人,2025年)使用2D模型独立处理视频帧,从而努力保持跨帧的时间一致性.
近期的视频涂装方法(周.等人,2023年;江 Jiang等人,2025年;李 al等人,2025年a)没有明确的模型对象副作用,导致非自然清除结果.
现有的视频物体清除方法(Miao等人,2025年;Fu等人,2026年)缺乏物体及其副作用之间的瞬间相关性模型,因此经常产生被清除物体的文物和残留痕迹.
总体而言,StreamErase在使用26.06 FPS的同时,在ROSE-Benchmark和VOR-Eval上都持续取得了强效的性能,大大提高了比现有方法的效率.
除了标准的短视频评价之外,Tab. 2在5秒和30秒的视频上评价StreamErase. 流线 擦除在短片片段上仍然具有很强的竞争力,在扩展至30秒时保持可比较的视觉质量,最小的降解度,表明其可伸缩到更长的序列.

blocks.en:
Qualitative Evaluation. Qualitative comparisons are presented in Fig. 4 .
Video inpainting methods ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zi et al., 2025a ) often struggle to completely remove the target objects and their associated effects, leaving noticeable residuals and artifacts in the edited regions.
Previous object removal approaches, such as ROSE ( Miao et al., 2025 ) and EffectErase ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , achieve more effective object removal, but tend to suffer from flickering and blurring artifacts in highly dynamic scenarios with substantial object or camera motion.
In contrast, StreamErase effectively removes target objects and their associated effects, while maintaining temporal consistency, producing clean, coherent, and high-quality results.
Visual results on long videos are show in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh:
定性评价. 图4列出了定性比较。
视频涂装方法(Jiang等人,2025年;Zi等人,2025年a)经常挣扎于完全清除目标对象及其相关效果,在编辑区域留下了明显的残骸和文物.
以往的物体清除方法,如ROSE(Miao等人,2025年)和EffectErase(Fu等人,2026年),实现了更有效的物体清除,但在具有实质性物体或相机运动的高度动态的情景中,往往会受到闪烁和模糊文物的影响.
相比之下,StreamErase有效移除目标对象及其相关效应,同时保持时间一致性,产生干净,连贯,高质量的结果.
长视频的视觉结果以图6显示.

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: Three-Stage Distillation Pipeline. We conduct ablation experiments to assess the contribution of each stage in our pipeline, as summarized in Tab. 4 .
blocks.zh: 三圣消化管道. 正如Tab所总结的那样,我们进行了消化试验,以评估我们管道中每个阶段的贡献。 4 (英语).

blocks.en: Stage 1: High-Fidelity Foundation. Stage 1 establishes a high-fidelity foundation using full temporal-spatial attention. This stage provides comprehensive erasing capabilities, but its bidirectional formulation relies on Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with 100 Network Function Evaluations (NFEs), incurring heavy computational overhead and precluding efficient streaming inference.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:高品质基金会。 第1阶段利用全时空间关注建立了高诚信基础. 这一阶段提供全面的消除能力,但其双向配制依赖于具有100个网络函数评价(NFEs)的分类-无源指导(CFG),从而产生了沉重的计算间接费用,排除了高效流推论.

blocks.en:
Stage 2: Causal Streaming Adaptation. Stage 2 converts the foundation model into a streaming model through causal attention over sequential 3-frame chunks. This enables the desired streaming input-output paradigm while reducing the inference cost to 8 NFEs per chunk.
Despite achieving streaming capability, this autoregressive step still exhibits noticeable error accumulation across chunks, primarily manifest as progressive color shifts and visual degradation.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段:因果溪流适应。 第2阶段通过连续3帧块的因果关注,将基础模型转换成流模型. 这样可以实现理想的流式输入输出范式,同时将推论成本降低到每块8个NFE.
尽管取得了流线性能力,但这一自旋性步骤仍然显示出各块之间明显的误差积累,主要表现为逐渐变色和视觉退化。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of our three-stage distillation pipeline. Comparison of generation configurations and efficiency across the different stages. All metrics are evaluated on ROSE.
blocks.zh: 表3:我们三阶段蒸馏管道的损耗. 不同阶段的生成配置和效率比较. 所有衡量标准都通过ROSE进行评估。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation study on ROSE. Based on ROSE data, the removal performance improves progressively with the addition of the effect erasing loss ( ℒ EE \mathcal{L}_{\text{{EE}}} ), Multimodal Region Guidance (MMRG).
blocks.zh: 表4:关于ROSE的研究。 基于ROSE数据,移除性能随着效果消除损失(L EE\mathcal{L}_{\text{{E}}}),多式联运区域指南(MMRG)的加入而逐步改善.

blocks.en: Stage 3: One-Step stability. Stage 3 resolves the remaining efficiency and stability bottlenecks. Through one-step DMD, the generator reduces inference to a single NFE while avoiding iterative latent propagation. The distilled model preserves the high-fidelity erasing behavior from Stage 1 while maintaining the streaming capability introduced in Stage 2. As a result, it enables ultra-low-latency video erasing with substantially improved stability and no observable error accumulation.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:一步稳定。 第三阶段解决了剩余的效率和稳定瓶颈。 通过一步的DMD,生成器将推论减少为单一的NFE,同时避免迭代的潜在传播. 蒸馏模型保留了从第一阶段开始的高纯度消除行为,同时保持了第二阶段引入的流线能力. 因此,它使超低频视频能够消除,其稳定性大大提高,没有明显的误差积累。

blocks.en: Model Components. We further investigate the key design choices in our method.
blocks.zh: 模型组件。 我们进一步调查我们方法中的关键设计选择。

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Effect Erasing Loss. The proposed EE loss encourages model focus on side-effect regions, strengthening its attention to the affected areas.
As shown in the Tab. 4 , adding the EE loss consistently improves the baseline across all metrics, with PSNR increasing from 30.104 to 32.571.
blocks.zh:
消除效应损失的有效性。 拟议的EE损失鼓励模型侧重于副作用区域,加强对受影响地区的关注。
如塔布所示. 4,加上EE损失持续改善所有指标的基准,PSNR从30.104增加到32.571.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Multimodal Region Guidance. The MMRG module captures spatiotemporal correlations between objects and their side effects, enabling the model to localize and perceive affected regions.
As shown in Tab. 4 , MMRG enables the model to produce higher-quality erasure results, with SSIM improving significantly from 0.818 to 0.872.
blocks.zh:
《多式联运区域指南》的有效性。 MMRG模块捕捉物体与其副作用之间的瞬间关联,使模型能够定位和感知受影响的区域.
如塔布所示. 4,MMRG使模型能够产生质量更高的消除结果,SSIM从0.818大幅提升到0.872.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Impact of Sparse Attention Patterns. Using longer clips (average 486 frames) from the LongErase, we ablate attention sink size and local window size in extrapolation scenarios. Having at least a single sink chunk is crucial, but more provides marginal benefit, while larger window sizes degrade performance as attending to long-past history allows errors to accumulate in context tokens.
blocks.zh: 图5:Sparse关注模式的影响。 使用LongErase的更长的剪辑(平均486帧),在推算情景中,我们降低注意力沉积大小和当地窗口大小. 拥有至少一个汇块至关重要,但更多的能提供边际好处,而较大的窗口大小会降低性能,因为要处理长期历史,允许在上下文符号中积累错误。

blocks.en: 4.3 Long-Video Streaming Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 长视频流分析

blocks.en: We investigate three key design choices governing streaming quality and interactivity: the latent chunk size, the attention sink size, and the local context window size.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了三种关于流线质量和交互作用的关键设计选择:潜在块大小、注意力槽大小和本地背景窗口大小。

blocks.en:
Impact of Chunk Size. The chunk size, which defines how many video latents are processed in parallel, presents a critical trade-off between quality, latency, and throughput.
As shown in Fig. 7 , small chunks yield lower throughput, while large chunks ( > > 3) cause prohibitive latency for real-time interaction.
Furthermore, Tab. 5 shows that a chunk size of 1 severely degrades quality.
We thus select 3 as our default chunk size (see Appendix B for details).
blocks.zh:
春克大小的影响. 块大小决定了平行处理的影视潜伏物数量,在质量、耐久性和吞吐量之间作出了重要的权衡。
如图7所示,小块的吞吐量较低,大块( > > 3) 对实时互动造成令人无法忍受的延迟。
还有,塔布 5 显示1块的面积严重降低质量。
因此,我们选择3作为默认块大小(详见附录B)。

blocks.en: Table 5: Long-video streaming design analysis on LongErase. c3s1w1 achieves the best visual quality and long-term stability.
blocks.zh: 表5 LongErase上的长视频流线设计分析. c3s1w1实现最佳视觉质量和长期稳定性.

blocks.en:
Attention Sink and Context Window. To evaluate attention sinks and window sizes, we train a single model with randomly sampled configurations and test long-video extrapolation on LongErase (average 486 frames).
Surprisingly, we find that the minimal configuration (a single-chunk sink with a single-chunk window) achieves the best performance.
Fig. 5 (a) shows that additional sinks offer marginal gains while increasing latency, and expanded windows degrade performance.
We hypothesize that restricting context to immediate predecessors mitigates error accumulation and reduces drift for long-video generation.
blocks.zh:
注意下沉和上下文窗口。 为了评价注意力汇和窗口大小,我们用随机抽样的配置来训练一个单一模型,并在LongErase(平均486帧)上测试长视频外推法.
令人惊讶的是,我们发现最小的配置(一个带有单弹簧窗口的单弹簧槽)达到了最佳的性能.
图5(a)显示,额外的汇在增加延迟性的同时提供边际收益,扩大的窗口会降低性能。
我们假设,将上下文限制在近期的前辈会减少误差积累,减少长视频生成的漂移。

blocks.en:
We additionally show reconstruction accuracy and throughput as well as their time evolution in Tab. 5 and Fig. 5 (b,c) respectively.
We denote our default configuration ( chunk-3, sink-1, window-1 ) as c3s1w1 .
In contrast, Self Forcing uses a sliding window approach ( c3s0w6 ) that attends to up to 6 previous chunks without sink tokens and employs unbounded RoPE positions scaling with frame count.
Although removing sink tokens ( c3s0w1 ) yields marginal speed improvements, this comes at the cost of degraded long-term generation stability.
blocks.zh:
我们还分别在图5和图5(b,c)中显示重建的准确性和吞吐量及其时间演变。
我们表示默认配置( 块-3, 槽-1, 窗口-1 )为 c3s1w1 。
相比之下,Self Forcing则采用滑动窗口方法(c3s0w6),它处理最多6个之前没有沉淀符的块,并使用无约束的RoPE位置按帧数缩放.
虽然去除沉淀物(c3s0w1)产生边际速度改进,但这要以退化的长期生成稳定性为代价.

blocks.zh: 图6:长视频擦除和流化Demo的可视化. 我们的方法支持灵活的长度视频擦除,同时保持高度的视觉忠诚.

blocks.zh: 我们还开发一个互动演示,在流体生成过程中支持实时用户控制. 图6显示了一个例子。

blocks.en: 5 conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we presented StreamErase, a novel streaming video erasing framework that successfully adapts powerful
bidirectional diffusion priors to an efficient, unidirectional
autoregressive paradigm. To overcome the attention distribution shift inherent in causal execution, we introduced a progressive three-stage distillation pipeline with attention sink and rolling KV caches.
StreamErase achieves strong performance across diverse real-world video erasing scenarios, while being significantly faster than prior methods. Limitations and future directions are discussed in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了StreamErase, 一个小说流 视频消除框架 成功适应强大的
双向传播先于高效、单向
自动递减模式。 为了克服因果执行中固有的注意力分配转移,我们引入了渐进式的三阶段蒸馏管道,并配有注意力吸收和滚动的KV缓存.
StreamErase在各种现实世界的视频消除情景中取得了强劲的性能,同时显著快于以往的方法. 附录F讨论了限制和未来的方向。

blocks.zh: 图7:速度和质量取舍与春克大小和采样步骤。 我们利用默认的c3s1w1(右)设置,在不同的块大小和采样步骤(左)和不同采样步骤的视频质量(LPIPS)上,可以直观地看到纬度-通量关系。

blocks.en: Impact of Chunk Size and Sampling Steps. In the main paper, we primarily focused on evaluating the efficiency of diverse sparse attention patterns with attention sink size and attention window size. As shown in Table 5 and Figure 5 , reducing the chunk size increases the number of autoregressive rollouts required to generate the same length of video while reducing the amount of bidirectional attention, leading to worse performance. Since chunk sizes beyond 3 induce high latency, which makes them less useful for our interactive use case, we report only speed metrics for these configurations. Figure 7 (a) visualizes the latency and throughput given different chunk sizes and sampling steps. Note that since all benchmarks are conducted with a sink size and a window size of 1, the model with chunk size 7 has lower FPS than the one with chunk size 3 because its attention sequence length is longer.
blocks.zh: 春克大小和采样步骤的影响. 在主要文件中,我们主要侧重于评价各种分散的注意模式的效率,注意的大小和注意的窗口大小。 如表5和图5所示,减少块大小将增加产生同样长度的视频所需的自动滚动次数,同时减少双向注意力,导致性能下降。 由于超过3的块大小会引起高耐久性,因此它们对我们的交互使用案例用处不大,因此我们只报告这些配置的速度度量. 图7(a)可视化不同块大小和取样步骤的耐久性和吞吐量。 请注意,由于所有基准都采用1号沉积大小和窗口大小,7号块的模型的FPS比3号块的模型低,因为其注意力序列长度较长。

blocks.en: The number of sampling steps per chunk also affects this balance. We train our student model for 4-step generation, which we find to be optimal for our setup; increasing beyond 4 steps yields only marginal quality gains, while reducing to 2 steps causes a noticeable drop in quality, as shown in Figure 7 (b). Although trained for 4-step inference, the DMD framework allows for flexible sampling configurations at test time. Based on these findings, we use a chunk size of 3 with 1 sampling step as our primary configuration to achieve a strong balance between interactivity and high-quality video generation.
blocks.zh: 每块取样步骤的数目也影响到这种平衡。 我们为四步一代培养我们的学生模式,我们认为这对我们的设置来说是最佳的;超过四步的提高只产生微不足道的质量收益,而减少到两步则造成质量明显下降,如图7(b)所示。 虽然经过了4步推论的训练,但DMD框架允许在测试时间进行灵活的采样配置. 基于这些发现,我们使用一个带1个采样步骤的3块大小作为我们的主要配置,在互动和高质量视频生成之间实现有力的平衡.

blocks.en: Appendix C Details of the training modules
blocks.zh: 附录C 培训单元的细节

blocks.en:
The MLP maps the object-image features extracted by the image encoder into the latent space required by our model. It is composed of two sequential MLP blocks: the first transforms the input embedding dimension to the output dimension, and the second further refines the representation with a residual MLP.
Each block applies LayerNorm ( Ba et al., 2016 ) , a linear projection, a GELU activation ( Hendrycks, 2016 ) , and a second linear projection, while the second block includes a residual connection.
A final LayerNorm is applied to stabilize the projected token.
blocks.zh:
MLP将图像编码器提取的物体-图像特征映射到我们模型所需要的潜在空间. 它由两个相继的 MLP 块组成:第一个是将输入嵌入维度转换为输出维度,第二个是用剩余 MLP 来进一步完善表示.
每个区块都应用TyleNorm(Ba等人,2016年),线性投影,GELU激活(Hendrycks,2016年),以及第二次线性投影,而第二个区块包括一个剩余连接.
最终的LayerNorm用于稳定预测的符号.

blocks.en: To provide a comprehensive breakdown of our proposed model, we present detailed per-category quantitative evaluations on the ROSE benchmark in Tab. 6 . Specifically, we analyze the performance evolution across our three progressive stages: • Stage 1 (High-Fidelity Initialization) : Establishes a strong structural foundation and delivers strong reconstruction quality across general lighting scenarios. It achieves particularly strong performance in the Common and Shadow subsets. • Stage 2 (Streaming Adaptation) : Serves as a intermediate phase to enable continuous processing capability. While it introduces a minor trade-off in reconstruction fidelity, it preserves consistent structural stability across all sub-categories. • Stage 3 (DMD) : Reclaims and further improves overall visual quality, consistently achieving the highest average metrics across the benchmark. It demonstrates remarkable gains in complex optical categories such as Light Source, Reflection, Mirror, and Translucent, significantly outperforming the preceding stages.

blocks.en:
While Stage 1 achieves superior frame-level synthesis owing to its non-causal bidirectional full attention, it lacks the temporal causality required for real-time streaming applications.
In Stage 2, the transition to a chunk-wise causal attention architecture enables causal streaming generation. However, because inference relies on autoregressively conditioning on generated latents under a teacher-forcing distillation formulation, small discrepancy errors inevitably aggregate over successive chunks.
As illustrated in the third column of Figure 9 , this leads to severe error accumulation and temporal drift over time, manifested as color shift, boundary blurriness, and dynamic structure degradation (e.g., distorted backgrounds and blurred moving subjects).
blocks.zh:
虽然第1阶段由于其非因果双向全心全意而实现了优异的帧级合成,但它缺乏实时流化应用所需的时间因果关系.
在第二阶段中,向块性因果注意结构的过渡使得因果流产生成为可能。 然而,由于推论依赖于教师强制蒸馏配方下产生的潜伏物的自旋性条件,因此小的差错必然会累积到连续块上。
如图9第三栏所示,这导致了严重的误差累积和时间随时间推移,表现为色变、边界模糊和动态结构退化(如扭曲的背景和模糊的移动主体)。

blocks.en:
Crucially, Stage 3 resolves this error propagation bottleneck.
By employing Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with the Stage 1 full-attention DiT acting as the real-score teacher, the 1-step generator G θ G_{\theta} aligns the generated latent distribution directly with the true distribution at a single timestep.
This global distribution alignment effectively mitigates the severe drift observed in Stage 2.
As shown in the final column, Stage 3 eliminates error accumulation, delivering sharp, visually coherent, and temporally continuous erasing results that over the quality of the Stage 1 foundation model while benefiting from ultra-low latency streaming inference.

这种全球分布调整有效地缓解了第二阶段观察到的严重漂移。
如最后一栏所示,第3阶段消除了错误积累,提供了尖锐、视觉连贯和时间连续的消除结果,这些结果超越了第1阶段的基础模型的质量,同时受益于超低温流推论。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitation and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: While StreamErase enables real-time streaming video object erasing over arbitrarily long horizons, we identify several limitations. First, the fixed-context causal generation mechanism, together with attention sinks, can become less effective when the video undergoes substantial scene changes over long horizons. The model tends to preserve information from earlier contexts, which is beneficial for maintaining temporal consistency but may limit its ability to fully adapt to newly emerging scenes. Future work could explore more adaptive context management and attention mechanisms that dynamically balance historical consistency with the ability to respond to major scene transitions.
blocks.zh: 在流时 擦除可以实时流传的视频对象 消除任意的长视野,我们发现一些局限性。 首先,当视频在漫长的视野中发生实质性的场景变化时,固定文本因果生成机制,加上注意力汇,可能变得不那么有效. 该模型倾向于从早期的背景中保存信息,这有利于保持时间一致性,但可能限制其充分适应新出现的场景的能力. 今后的工作可以探索更具适应性的环境管理和关注机制,在历史一致性与应对重大场景过渡的能力之间实现动态平衡。

blocks.en: Second, the performance of StreamErase is still constrained by the availability and diversity of training data for video object erasing. Existing video erasing datasets are relatively limited in scale, duration, and coverage of real-world scenarios, making it challenging to fully capture the diverse object appearances, camera motions, occlusions, and scene changes encountered in practical applications. Future work could focus on constructing large-scale, diverse, and realistic video erasing datasets with longer videos and more challenging real-world scenarios, which could further improve the robustness and generalization of streaming erasing models.
blocks.zh: 其次,StreamErase的性能仍然受到视频对象消除培训数据的提供和多样性的限制. 现有的视频擦除数据集在规模,持续时间,以及真实世界情景的覆盖范围方面相对有限,因此难以完全捕捉到在实际应用中遇到的各种物体外观,相机运动,隐蔽,场景变化. 今后的工作可以侧重于建造大规模、多样和现实的视频,用更长的视频和更具挑战性的现实世界情景来消除数据集,这可以进一步提高流媒体消除模式的稳健性和普遍性。

blocks.en: Lastly, StreamErase currently relies on explicit mask inputs to specify the objects to be removed. While masks provide precise spatial control, requiring users to manually provide them introduces additional interaction cost and limits the flexibility of the system. A promising direction is to develop video erasing models that do not require explicit mask inputs, allowing users to specify unwanted objects through natural-language instructions or simple interactions such as clicking on the target object. Such a design could further reduce the burden of user input and enable a more natural and accessible interactive video erasing experience.
blocks.zh: 最后,流线 擦除当前依赖于明确的遮罩输入来指定要移除的对象. 虽然口罩提供精确的空间控制,但要求用户手动提供口罩会增加互动成本并限制系统的灵活性. 一个有希望的方向是开发不需要明确遮罩输入的视频擦除模型,允许用户通过自然语言指令或简单的交互比如点击目标对象来指定不想要的对象. 这种设计可进一步减轻用户输入的负担,并促成更自然、更方便的交互式录像删除经验。
